inputs.name: hand over from Training Pipeline to Model Evaluation Harness

output.level_0: Data fails to transfer between Training Pipeline and Model Evaluation Harness, causing evaluation delays.
output.level_1: Hand over process from Training Pipeline to Model Evaluation Harness is undefined, requiring urgent setup.
output.level_2: Engineers manually copy trained models into Model Evaluation Harness, risking errors and delays.
output.level_3: Training Pipeline automatically sends models to Model Evaluation Harness, but no monitoring is in place.
output.level_4: Training Pipeline hands over models to Model Evaluation Harness, with tracking and alerts for failures.
